title: Investor-visible formula registry (finance-safe)
authority: Code + sealed tests beat papers/recipe marketing copy. Papers cite intent; this file cites what ships.

formulas.name: Live gap vs price target (%)
formulas.expression: (fair_px_med - price_live) / price_live

reference.cite: Paper-2 §6 fair-value triangulation; live tape-relative gap uses median fair px

formulas.name: Live gap vs price target ($)
formulas.expression: fair_px_med - price_live

reference.cite: Paper-2 §6 — dollar gap companion to F_VS_MEDIAN_PCT

formulas.name: Frozen research margin of safety
formulas.expression: fair_px_med / price_at_build - 1  (sealed on vector; may diverge from live vs)

reference.cite: Paper-2 §6 / recipes LITERATURE_BINDS mos_live

formulas.name: MoS ↔ live-gap algebraic identity
formulas.expression: fair/p - 1 === (fair - p) / p when price basis matches

reference.cite: Algebra identity; UI hides MoS when |mos - vs| < 0.005

formulas.name: Show Research MoS only when it disagrees with live gap
formulas.expression: show iff |mos_live - vs_median_pct| >= 0.005

reference.cite: Trust: never display duplicate identical MoS and vs-target

formulas.name: Live tape must still show value gap for BUY
formulas.expression: BUY requires gap_to_median > 0 in addition to sealed mos_live > 0

reference.cite: HF underwriting: sealed MoS is not live intrinsic value; tape must still clear vs-target

formulas.name: Fair-value band ordering
formulas.expression: 0 < fair_px_lo <= fair_px_med <= fair_px_hi

reference.cite: Paper-2 triangulated lo/med/hi lenses

formulas.name: Price vs fair band zone
formulas.expression: below if price < lo; above if price > hi; else inside

reference.cite: Option B: above-band names flagged, not silently ranked as bargains

formulas.name: Universe recipe score (MAD robust-z)
formulas.expression: z = winsor±3((x - med) / (1.4826 * MAD)); contrib = z * w; score = Σ contrib

reference.cite: Paper util MAD/winsor (scripts/saas_ai/analysis/util.py convention); R3 weights rd_prod×1.5, fcfm_sbc×1, roic×1, mos_live×1.5

formulas.name: Score requires contribution drivers
formulas.expression: score != 0 ⇒ ∃ contribution ≠ 0

reference.cite: Fail-closed: never show a score with empty drivers

formulas.name: Auto-sell / trim ceiling
formulas.expression: live < med → sell=med; med ≤ live < hi → sell=hi; live ≥ hi → past_ceiling at hi; upside = sell/live - 1

reference.cite: docs/SELL_CEILING.md — first-principles band exit, not a forecast

formulas.name: Hold horizon buckets (1y/2y/3y)
formulas.expression: gap>0: gap≥0.6→3y; gap≥0.25→2y; else 1y

reference.cite: docs/CLOSE_CALL_STANCE.md — shared buckets with stance

formulas.name: Implied annualized close of gap
formulas.expression: (target / live)^(1/H) - 1   OR   (1 + gap)^(1/H) - 1

reference.cite: Convergence math only — not a forecast

formulas.name: Research BUY hard gates
formulas.expression: ¬kill ∧ completeness∈{A,B} ∧ mos_live>0 ∧ catalyst known ∧ agg_score≥65 ∧ confidence∈{med,high}

reference.cite: docs/CLOSE_CALL_STANCE.md

formulas.name: USD display (4 significant digits)
formulas.expression: Intl USD currency, maximumSignificantDigits=4

reference.cite: Consistent investor-facing precision

formulas.name: Compact USD (T/B/M/K)
formulas.expression: ≥1e12→T; ≥1e9→B; ≥1e6→M; ≥1e3→K; else formatUsd4

reference.cite: Revenue scale without inventing precision

formulas.name: Percent display (4 sig figs, optional sign)
formulas.expression: Intl percent, maximumSignificantDigits=4; signed via signDisplay exceptZero

reference.cite: Same formatter as parity e2e

formulas.name: Panel fundamentals (no live recompute)
formulas.expression: rd_prod, fcfm_sbc, roic, gm, rev_cagr, retention — sealed vector / panel CSV pass-through; never imputed

reference.cite: Paper-1 §4 rd_prod (Lev–Sougiannis); Paper-2 quality / owner earnings for fcfm_sbc; Novy-Marx ROIC/GM

formulas.name: Company DCF workbench triangulation
formulas.expression: fair_ev from {ev_fcf, ev_norm, ev_mult}; fair_px=(EV+net_cash)/shares; mos=clip(fair_px_med/price-1)

reference.cite: Paper-2 §6 — Universe fair band is sealed panel pass-through, not live DCF replay

formulas.name: 20-session average dollar volume
formulas.expression: mean(close * volume) over last 20 sessions with both known

reference.cite: Capacity / tradability strip — not a BUY gate; UNKNOWN when volume missing

formulas.name: PIT BUY-set forward return
formulas.expression: P_t+h / P_t - 1 for sealed BUY membership at as_of t (equal-weight book)

reference.cite: Distinct from paper HML_RD / RD20 — tracks research BUY clearance sets only

formulas.name: Simulated BUY study proxy gates (pre-registered)
formulas.expression: G1 sealed MoS>0 · G2 gap-to-median at sim date>0 · G3 PIT tape event · G4 completeness proxy — per contracts/simulated-buy-gates.json

reference.cite: SIMULATED robustness study — look-ahead contaminated by construction (fair bands, grades, membership); never the sealed track record

formulas.name: RD composite + top-quintile eligibility (paper spine proxy)
formulas.expression: rd_composite = mean(robust_z(rd_int), robust_z(rd_capital), robust_z(rd_prod), robust_z(rd_mom)); rd_elig = rd_composite ≥ Q80(universe)

reference.cite: HML_RD paper — cross-sectional R&D premium. The composite is a within-universe quintile PROXY for the paper cohort, not the July–June formation; never a per-name return claim.

formulas.name: Survivability hard floors
formulas.expression: (fcfm_sbc > 0 ∨ rule40 ≥ 40) ∧ runway_yrs ≥ 2 (UNKNOWN tolerated iff FCF>0) ∧ dilution_ann ≤ 0.08 ∧ retention ≥ 0.90 (UNKNOWN tolerated) — thresholds sealed in contracts/thesis-gates.json

reference.cite: Declared floors, not validated survival predictors — a cheap high-R&D company that dies never collects the factor premium. Any required UNKNOWN blocks BUY.

formulas.name: Payoff skew from the sealed fair band
formulas.expression: (fair_px_hi − price) / (price − fair_px_lo); price ≤ fair_px_lo → 'below band' (passes); gate floor 3:1

reference.cite: Band asymmetry — the band is a sealed model output, not market data. Skew justifies the shape of the bet, never its size.

formulas.name: Market-implied repricing probability p*
formulas.expression: p* = (price − fair_px_med_base) / (fair_px_med_bull − fair_px_med_base); p* < 0 ⇒ the repricing thesis is a free option

reference.cite: Inverted scenario maths: we never assign a probability to the AI-SaaS repricing thesis; we display what the market charges for it. Display only — never gates, never sizes.

formulas.name: Validated-evidence sizing bound (fractional Kelly on the conservative CI)
formulas.expression: μ_claim = max(0, λ_headline − 1.96·SE_NW); f_max = 0.25 · μ_claim / σ²_book; per-name w ≤ min(f_max/N_buy, 0.05·ADV20d·21/capital)

reference.cite: Headline annual HML_RD premium 3.73%/yr, NW SE 3.38 (t=1.10, not significant) → bound is ZERO today. The alternative rd_factor_premium (5.4%/yr, t=2.42) is displayed as supporting evidence but never sizes. No validated edge, no size.

formulas.name: Pre-registered falsification rules (thesis engine watchdog)
formulas.expression: R1 rolling 5y NW t(HML_RD) < 1.0 for 4 consecutive quarters → μ_claim := 0, BUY→HOLD · R2 sealed ledger n≥36 months with excess t < 0 → engine retired publicly · R3 MoS-bucket gap-closure calibration off > 2× → band model revision

reference.cite: contracts/falsification-rules.json — registered before evidence accrues. Rules display and demand action; nothing retires silently.
